svg.title: Synchronous update time
svg.desc: Current engine compared with the intermediate baseline used in the November 12 animation measurement. Each workload uses a separate zero-based absolute scale, with endpoints printed below its marks. Whiskers show recorded minimum and maximum, not confidence intervals. SVG · 12 reshaping lenses: previous median 34.2333 ms, range 33.8771 to 35.9913; current median 10.7855 ms, range 10.6825 to 11.0537. SVG · 24 reshaping lenses: previous median 58.3111 ms, range 58.2683 to 59.2887; current median 21.0863 ms, range 21.0779 to 21.2418. SVG · 24 cached movement lenses: previous median 0.184091 ms, range 0.173714 to 0.196591; current median 0.186441 ms, range 0.185795 to 0.196067. WebGL · 24 reshaping lenses: previous median 6.59208 ms, range 6.4083 to 7.25439; current median 6.54315 ms, range 6.45708 to 6.6668. WebGL · 24 cached movement lenses: previous median 0.28125 ms, range 0.272614 to 0.285062; current median 0.280913 ms, range 0.26473 to 0.305417. 5 trials/build · median of trial means. Async decode and GPU completion excluded
